blocks.text: 🪝 IRDAI Grants Health Insurance License to Prudential HCL Joint Venture. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Grants standalone health insurance registration to Prudential HCL Health Insurance (70:30 JV).
Equity Structure: Prudential plc holds 70% stake, HCL Group holds 30% stake.
Separate Acquisition: Prudential plc acquired 75% stake in Bharti Life Insurance.
Prudential stake in Prudential HCL Health (70%) vs stake in Bharti Life (75%).
